# BusinessDojo

> BusinessDojo provides free business plan templates, financial planning examples, and startup resources for entrepreneurs launching new ventures.

BusinessDojo (operated by PCJJM PTE LTD in Singapore) offers customizable, ready-to-use business planning documents and templates designed to help startups and entrepreneurs develop comprehensive business strategies. The platform combines practical examples with market research tools and financial forecasting capabilities.

## Business Planning Templates & Examples

- [A Free Example of Business Plan](https://dojobusiness.com/pages/a-free-sample-of-business-plan): Free business plan example for fruit juice bar startup planning with comprehensive market analysis and operational strategy
- [A Free Example of a Financial Plan](https://dojobusiness.com/pages/financial-plan-example): Free financial plan template featuring forecasts, break-even analysis, and revenue projections for startup planning
